parameters.name: SORTKEY1
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu as the new PRIMARY sort key.

parameters.name: S_ORDER1
parameters.help: This dictates the order of the output ensembles.

parameters.name: SORTKEY2
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu as the new SECONDARY sort key.

parameters.name: S_ORDER2
parameters.help: This dictates the order of the output ensembles.

parameters.name: SORTKEY3
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu as the new TERTIARY sort key.

parameters.name: S_ORDER3
parameters.help: This dictates the order of traces within each output ensemble.

choices.label: Ascending
choices.help: Output traces with the secondary key in ASCENDING order.

choices.label: Descending
choices.help: Output traces with the secondary key in DESCENDING order.

parameters.name: SORTKEY4
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu as the new QUATERNARY sort key.

parameters.name: S_ORDER4
parameters.help: This dictates the order of traces within each output ensemble.

choices.label: Ascending
choices.help: Output traces with the secondary key in ASCENDING order.

choices.label: Descending
choices.help: Output traces with the secondary key in DESCENDING order.

parameters.name: MAX_DTRZ
parameters.help: What is the maximum number of traces per ensemble AFTER sorting?  For a CDP sort, this is the maximum fold.

parameters.name: N_BUFFER
parameters.help: How many traces must be buffered?  For a normal CDP sort, this is max fold multiplied by chans per record.

parameters.name: MEDIA
parameters.help: Use MB1 to rotate between choices for buffering traces to disk (large but slow) or memory (small but fast).

parameters.name: ENDENSKY
parameters.help: Use MB1 to rotate between choices for End-Of-Ensemble key.  Line-Segment-End will be the key above the End-Of-Ensemble key.

choices.label: Primary
choices.help: End-Ensemble set when PRIMARY key changes

choices.label: Secondary
choices.help: End-Ensemble set when SECONDARY key changes

choices.label: Tertiary
choices.help: End-Ensemble set when TERTIARY key changes

choices.label: Quaternary
choices.help: End-Ensemble set when QUATERNARY key changes

parameters.name: COMPRESS
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to reduce storage requirements by compressing the data before sorting.

parameters.name: MULTPASS
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' if buffer is not big enough for sort. Refer to help file for procedure.

parameters.name: AUTOTEST
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' if sort should stay the same as input primary/secondary keys and add DS_SEQNO as tertiary sort key

parameters.name: AUTOTERT
parameters.help: Enter tertiary sort key name for autotests
